maxTokens.description: Cap on a single supervisor reply. Too low truncates mid-answer; the ceiling is model-specific (deepseek-chat maxes at 8192).

appearance.description: Customize the look and feel of the interface

colorTheme.label: Color theme
colorTheme.description: Choose between light and dark appearance, or follow your system setting.

language.label: Display language
language.description: Choose the language used across the interface, or follow your system setting.

autoGroupTools.label: Auto-group tools
autoGroupTools.description: Collapse consecutive tool calls into a single group. Disable to keep every tool call and in-between thinking row visible on its own.

avoidGroupingEdits.label: Avoid grouping edits
avoidGroupingEdits.description: Treat Edit and Write tool calls as standalone rows, even when auto-grouping is enabled. Reads before and after an edit will form separate groups.

autoExpandTools.label: Auto-expand tool results
autoExpandTools.description: Temporarily expand completed tool calls, then collapse them again after a short delay. Disable to keep tool rows stable unless you open them yourself.

expandEditWrite.label: Expand Edit and Write tools by default
expandEditWrite.description: Start Edit and Write tool calls open when they appear. Disable to keep them collapsed until you open them.

showToolIcons.label: Show tool icons
showToolIcons.description: Display icons next to tool call labels. Disable for a text-only view.

coloredToolIcons.label: Colored tool icons
coloredToolIcons.description: Tint tool call icons with per-tool colors. Disable for monochrome icons.

windowLayout.label: Window layout
windowLayout.description: Choose how panels are arranged in the window.

coloredSidebarIcons.label: Colored sidebar icons
coloredSidebarIcons.description: Tint tool picker and panel header icons with per-tool colors. Disable for neutral monochrome icons.

islandShine.label: Island border shine
islandShine.description: Show a subtle diagonal reflection on island panel borders. Only visible in island layout mode.

backgroundEffect.descriptionMacLiquidGlass: Choose the native macOS background material. Blur Off keeps the window opaque, while switching from Liquid Glass to Vibrancy needs a restart.
backgroundEffect.descriptionMacNoLiquidGlass: Choose the native macOS background material. Liquid Glass is unavailable on this Mac, so Vibrancy and Off are available.
backgroundEffect.descriptionGlassSupported: Allow the desktop to show through the window background. Uses Mica on Windows when enabled.
backgroundEffect.descriptionGlassUnsupported: Window transparency is not available on this platform.

transparentToolPicker.label: Transparent tool picker
transparentToolPicker.description: Remove the background from the right-side tool picker strip so icons float directly over the window.
